explanation: The response overlaps only in predicting increased lattice heat conductivity and mentioning SRO-related phonon scattering. It fails to reconstruct the material, intervention, simulation conditions, structural mediator, baseline, and central mechanism. The proposed impurity-resonance mechanism is unsupported and physically questionable because resonant impurities commonly add phonon-scattering channels. Its comparison experiment could test its own claim at a basic level, but it would not discriminate the target explanation involving SRO percolation and reduced lattice distortion.
